solutions.title: Check each candidate square
solutions.strategy: Try every top-left corner and square side length, scanning each candidate for a zero cell.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell can test O(min(rows, cols)) sizes and each size can scan a square.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and the best side length are stored.

solutions.title: DP border extension
solutions.strategy: Let each DP cell store the largest all-one square side ending at that matrix cell.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each matrix cell is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table stores one side length per matrix position.
